content:
nina: FYI - WaveBank usage dropped ~55% over the past 10 days. Their CSM flagged that the Head of Ops (our main sponsor, Devika) is on leave and procurement looped in a security lead. They mentioned a competitor trial starting next Tues. Renewal in 4 months.

raph: Thanks. I spoke with Devika's backup (Owen) this morning. He's concerned about integration effort and cost per inference. They requested a security checklist, a short TCO slide, and examples of token savings.

harry: Onboarding backlog: unresolved webhook mappings, missing analytics export, and template tuning. Webhooks can be turned around today if we get API admin token. Analytics export requires a report run from infra.

maria: Ops note: we can provision a short-lived staging tenant for a competitive POC mirror. opsbot, can you create wavebank-poc-staging for 2 weeks? Approver: raph.

opsbot: opsbot: Provisioning request received for "wavebank-poc-staging". Estimated ETA 8 hours. Please confirm approver: raph.

nina: Proposed immediate plan: 1) AE intro + security call between our infra lead and their security lead (raph) 2) Offer 14-day staging tenant with sample replay of last 7 days' traffic 3) Fast-track webhooks + analytics export 4) Deliver 1-page TCO + 3 demo flows tailored to their use cases

raph: Agreed. I'll do intro and schedule security sync for tomorrow AM. Can someone assemble the TCO numbers? I need sample token counts and current inference latencies.

harry: I'll export the last 30 days token CSV and send it here. Quick sample: 30d total = 210k tokens, avg latency = 420ms. Full CSV incoming.

maria: I'll prep the staging tenant once opsbot finishes provisioning and will seed with replay data. Also will create a short checklist: SSO, webhook URL, test payload, analytics export command.

nina: Can we offer a conditional credit (20k tokens) if they run the staging tenant and accept a 1-hour technical review at the end? That usually helps retention.

raph: Approve provisional 20k credit. I'll confirm with sales-ops for formal sign-off.

harry: ETA for webhooks + analytics export: webhooks today (once token provided), analytics export by EOD with the CSV.

opsbot: opsbot: "wavebank-poc-staging" provisioning complete. Admin invite sent to raph.

nina: Great. Meeting: 30m sync tomorrow 10am ET to align deliverables and confirm presenters. Action owners: raph (AE + security intro), harry (token CSV + analytics), maria (staging + checklist), nina (TCO + demo flows + provisional credit). I'll update SFDC: flag = competitive-poc and tag renewal.

raph: Sent intro to Owen + security lead. Owen requested a one-page integration checklist to share with their VP. I'll wait for maria's checklist and nina's TCO to forward.

maria: Uploading checklist to #shared-cs-resources now. It includes SSO steps, required headers, sample webhook payload, and analytics export CLI.

nina: Thanks team. If they commit to the POC, we'll follow the standard renewal play and loop in Renewals Owner.

raph: :thumbsup:
